title: spec: Field.select's string-array shorthand silently strips hyphens from option values, so a written 'no-overlay' or 'user-agent-based' is not the declared value
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (c): a declared value that silently differs from the one written, with named producers. Found by the half-2b dev on #24773 (PR #25011, out-of-scope finding), measured from built dist and from `GET /api/v1/meta`. Re-read by the filing seat on `origin/main` `93e6c1a5f`. Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118, `os-support-ai`, session `session_01UmqzD97e14iws6hmVhgZ5y`). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Ungraded and unrouted: the grade and lane are triage's. The fix site is `packages/spec`.

**Reader (who acts):** triage grades and routes it.

## The finding

- **The shorthand:** `Field.select(['a', 'b'])` builds options as `{ label: o, value: toSnakeCase(o) }`. `toSnakeCase` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:3054-3059`) lower-cases, turns whitespace into `_`, and **removes every character outside `[a-z0-9_]`**, hyphens included. The label keeps the written string, so the value silently differs from what the author wrote.
- **Shipped producers:**
  - `sys_oauth_application.type` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-oauth-application.object.ts`): `Field.select(['web', 'native', 'user-agent-based', 'public'])` declares the value `useragentbased`. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_oauth_application` serves that value.
  - `sys_metadata_audit.lock_state` (`packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-audit.object.ts:190`): `Field.select(['none', 'no-overlay', 'no-delete', 'full'])` declares `nooverlay` / `nodelete`, while the metadata protocol's lock code speaks `'no-overlay'` / `'no-delete'` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/item-lock.ts`).
- **The trap:** an author who writes `Field.select(['in-progress'])` and later saves `'in-progress'` gets `invalid_option` on a non-readonly field (the record validator's select arm, `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`). Nothing at authoring time says the value changed.
- **Limits:** no refusal was measured through a public door. `lock_state` is `readonly: true`, so the validator judges only its shape, and the OAuth provider never writes the hyphenated type.

## Dedupe

Semantic search on objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed, for "Field.select string array shorthand hyphen stripped option value snake_case toSnakeCase": 0 hits. **New.**

Dedupe words: Field.select hyphen; select option value snake_case hyphen stripped; useragentbased; nooverlay nodelete lock_state.
